title: CPF Module Schema: Azure DNSZone module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-dnszone'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

a_record_enable.description: (Optional) A record configuration block as defined below. These value are required only when you need to create a records for the DNS Zone.

a_records.type: map(object({ name = string ttl = optional(number) records = optional(list(string), []) target_resource_id = optional(number) }))
a_records.description: "(Required) An `cname_record` for the Azure DNS Zone. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." object({ name = (Required) The name of the DNS A Record. Changing this forces a new resource to be created. ttl = (Required) The Time To Live (TTL) of the DNS record in seconds. records = (Optional) List of IPv4 Addresses. Conflicts with target_resource_id. target_resource_id = (Optional) The Azure resource id of the target object. Conflicts with records. })

cname_record_enable.description: (Optional) A CNAME record configuration block as defined below. These value are required only when you need to create a records for the DNS Zone.

cname_records.type: map(object({ name = string ttl = optional(number) record = optional(string) target_resource_id = optional(number) }))
cname_records.description: "(Required) An `cname_record` for the Azure DNS Zone. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." object({ name = (Required) The name of the DNS CNAME Record. Changing this forces a new resource to be created. ttl = (Required) The Time To Live (TTL) of the DNS record in seconds. record = (Optional) The target of the CNAME. target_resource_id = (Optional) The Azure resource id of the target object. Conflicts with record. })

dns_zone_name.description: (Required) The name of the Azure DNS Zone. • Name must have `1-63 characters`, `2 to 34 labels`, Each label is a set of characters separated by a period. For example, contoso.com has 2 labels.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

soa_record.type: object({ email = string expire_time = optional(string) minimum_ttl = optional(number) refresh_time = optional(number) retry_time = optional(number) ttl = optional(number) })
soa_record.description: "(Required) An `soa_record` for the Azure DNS Zone. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." object({ email = (Required) The email contact for the SOA record. expire_time = (Optional) The expire time for the SOA record. Defaults to 2419200. minimum_ttl = (Optional) The minimum Time To Live for the SOA record. By convention, it is used to determine the negative caching duration. Defaults to 300. refresh_time = (Optional) The refresh time for the SOA record. Defaults to 3600. retry_time = (Optional) The retry time for the SOA record. Defaults to 300. ttl = (Optional) The Time To Live of the SOA Record in seconds. Defaults to 3600. })

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

a_record_fqdn.description: A list of DNS A Record FQDN.

a_record_id.description: A list of DNS A Record ID.

cname_record_fqdn.description: The FQDN of the DNS CNAME Record.

id.description: The ID of the Azure DNS Zone.

name.description: The name of the Azure DNS Zone.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Dnszone' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
